records.title: Task-Agnostic Structured Pruning of Speech Representation Models
records.reason: The paper prunes speech representation models (wav2vec2/Hubert/WavLM); it does not study LLM inference or serving.

records.title: Unlocking Implicit Experience: Synthesizing Tool-Use Trajectories from Text
records.reason: The efficiency result concerns a specialized data/trajectory synthesis pipeline and tool-use benchmarks, rather than general user-facing LLM serving; evidence is too narrow for an unqualified follow-up.

records.title: AMAS: Adaptively Determining Communication Topology for LLM-based Multi-Agent System
records.reason: Although LLM inference latency is measured, results show little latency gain and the framework is an accuracy-oriented multi-agent topology method; efficiency relevance is weak.

records.title: TokenShapley: Token Level Context Attribution with Shapley Value
records.reason: TokenShapley addresses token-level attribution and retrieval-based explanation, not inference/serving efficiency.

records.title: FedSVD: Adaptive Orthogonalization for Private Federated Learning with LoRA
records.reason: FedSVD addresses differentially private federated LoRA training and gradient-noise behavior; it is a training method, not inference optimization.
